label: PF Backlog 82
title: Backlog ids collide across scopes - standardize scope-qualified references (links/item_id/artifacts/dashboard)
body:
Design holds: open.json/closed.json/counters.json/history/*.jsonl are the per-scope single source of truth (product-forge/backlog for the pipeline backend; products/

/backlog for each project incl. the dashboard). BI-#### are ids INSIDE those files. BUT ids are allocated per-scope by counters.json, so the SAME id exists in multiple scopes (observed: BI-0025..BI-0063 collide between product_forge and project:ProductForge-Dashboard - 39 collisions). A bare 'BI-0042' is therefore ambiguous. This breaks: cross-scope links (backend_item/dashboard_item), item_id references in derived .md/artifacts (feature-status.md, product-plan, agent_ledger), and the dashboard console. FIX: standardize a scope-qualified reference format (e.g. 'product_forge:BI-0042', 'project:ProductForge-Dashboard:BI-0042') used in links, item_id fields and derived artifacts; add a resolver (parse id -> load correct scope store); enforce in core/backlog.link and in the backlog API; migrate existing cross-links. Consider also a short scope prefix in labels for humans. Refs: core/backlog.py (_paths/_next_id/link), core/backlog_link.py, docs/INTAKE-AND-BACKLOG-DESIGN.md.
